summary: Tephra is an outgoing Hearthian child found with Galena on a Village porch. Tephra invites the protagonist to play hide-and-seek using the Signalscope and radios, serving as the Signalscope tutorial. They also voice anxiety about the protagonist disappearing like Feldspar did.

behavior: Tephra is outgoing and playful, contrasting Galena's shyness.
Tephra often plays all over the Village and sometimes gets in trouble for it.
Tephra likes mallows (marshmallows) and considers them their favorite.
location: Tephra is found with Galena on the front porch of a house in the Village.
After the protagonist's statue pairing, Tephra moves to the path between the Observatory and the Launch Tower.
lore: Tephra and Galena failed to borrow Moraine's Signalscope because Moraine considers it too delicate.
Tephra wanted to hide in the Observatory during hide-and-seek but Hornfels said they were 'making a nuisance of themselves.'
Tephra learned from Hornfels that Feldspar disappeared in space and was the best pilot ever.
Tephra worries the protagonist may disappear like Feldspar did, noting the protagonist is not as good as Feldspar.
Tephra makes the protagonist promise to play hide-and-seek again after returning from space.
mechanics: Tephra's hide-and-seek minigame serves as the Signalscope tutorial.
Game rules: Galena and Tephra hide with radios; the protagonist is 'it' and finds them using the Signalscope; last found wins.
Starting the minigame adds the 'Hide and Seek' frequency to the Signalscope.
Tephra notes their hiding spot is 'super good' when found first.
